I used Reflect when this was in Beta and free and liked the experience. However most of what you get from this, you can get from Obsidian as well... These days I am back to Bear since it's free, native, fast.

What drew me to Reflect (away from Obsidian) was full functionality out of the box without the need for plugins... Reflect is fully functional without any plugins to update (or get compromised or stop getting updated).
Props to Reflect for their security audit too. I will be keeping an eye on how they progress.
Been using Reflect since last year, definitely has one of the easiest interfaces to use.

Previous user of both [Mem and Reflect], but have opted to pay for Reflect, after Mem added AI features before adding a dark mode... Alex has been obsessed with customer feedback, answering support emails, and on discord, and it shows. Reflect is beautiful, fast and super secure.
Reflect founder: 'We're building it as a lifestyle company. There's only four of us. We bootstrapped for a while, and then did a $1m crowdfund... We're end-to-encrypted.'
Reflect founder on data lock-in: 'you can always export your notes into markdown or HTML so you shouldn't feel too locked in.' Also noted they didn't raise VC to avoid forced 'exit' events.
Question about Reflect's E2E encryption claims: 'We do not end-to-end encrypt things like files or images you upload' - user noted this excludes sensitive content like PDFs/contracts from encryption.
